facts.statement: A community event called Launch Pad Leap was held in Lakeshore on Thursday April 15th, 2010, with players meeting on the dock to bounce on the launch pads.
facts.quote: This week's Community Event is a Launch Pad Leap in Lakeshore! Meet up on the dock

facts.statement: The Lakeshore Launch Pad Leap ran at 3pm Pacific Time for U.S. and Latin America players on Server 1.
facts.quote: 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The Lakeshore Launch Pad Leap ran at 9:00am Pacific Time (6:00pm GMT) for UK and Europe players on Server 1.
facts.quote: 9:00am Pacific Time / 6:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A community event announcement for a 'Launch Pad Leap' in Lakeshore, where players gather on the dock to bounce on the launch pads together and then dance at a nearby dock. The post lists two start times (U.S./Latin America and UK/Europe) on Server 1 and explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar and its GO button.
